findings.issue: Hiphil jussive 2ms is causative and has no reflexive suffix; 'te amargues' turns it into a middle/reflexive and adds an unmarked pronoun.
The noun is masculine singular construct with a 2mp suffix; 'delitos' is plural.

notes: Tú matches the 2ms imperatives, ustedes matches the 2mp suffix, and the last clause stays verbless.
